== Title ==
<span lang="ja">予備パイロット</span>. Two asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋1。ブラック2、ブラック3、またはブラック4に乗っているなら、回避値＋1となる上に、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、1枚引ける。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">戦闘による負傷で第一線を退いたベイダー配下の精鋭タイ・パイロット。彼は交代要員として待機しており、いつでも死傷したパイロットの代わりを勤められる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Reserve Pilot]].

'''Lore''' — An elite TIE pilot under Vader who left the front line because of combat injuries. He waits as a replacement and can take the place of a dead or wounded pilot at any time.

'''Game text''' — Adds 1 to the power of any starship he pilots. If aboard Black 2, Black 3, or Black 4, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw 1 battle destiny if otherwise unable.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese lore says he left the front line from combat injuries and can replace dead or wounded pilots. English says injuries kept Vader's best TIE wingman out of the primary wave. Game text matches the Black 2/3/4 bonuses.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-reservepilot-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Reserve Pilot]].</ref>
